MRI Safety Information
The Lumen Spinal System has not been evaluated for safety in the MR environment.
It has not been tested for heating or unwanted movement in the MR environment. The safety of the Lumen Spinal System in the MR environment is unknown. Performing an MR exam on a person who has this medical device may result in injury or device malfunction.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
